protocol.data_source: raw CSVs → clean → REAL rows only (src/data/cv_data.py)
protocol.scaling: RobustScaler per feature group, fit on training fold only
protocol.resampling: adaptive SMOTE + BENIGN cap 200K, training fold only
protocol.test_fold: real rows only, no synthetic samples
protocol.validation_for_early_stopping: 10% of REAL training-fold rows, stratified, carved out before resampling
protocol.stage1_threshold: chosen per fold on the REAL validation split by maximising 13-class macro-F1; test fold untouched; applied to HiT-IDS AND to every baseline with saved validation probabilities (attack score = 1 - p(BENIGN))
